ko.executive_summary: China's AI chip shortage is redirecting eSSD supply from domestic to U.S. markets, with Samsung and SK Hynix shifting allocation. SK Hynix is executing aggressive workforce expansion in production roles with performance incentives reaching 2964% bonuses, signaling confidence in HPC demand scaling.
key_facts: Samsung and SK Hynix redirecting eSSD orders from China to U.S. due to AI chip shortage
HBM market projected to reach USD 69.75 billion
SK Hynix recruiting H2 production staff with bonus incentives exceeding 2964%
Hyperscalers committing billions to next-generation data center accelerators
CEA-Leti and Armenia discussing semiconductor research center establishment

implications.text: China-facing eSSD capacity diverted westward indicates geopolitical tensions reshaping semiconductor logistics; Korean suppliers gaining U.S. market access.
SK Hynix removing educational prerequisites and offering exceptional bonuses reflects acute production capacity pressure and talent scarcity in memory manufacturing.
Projected $69.75B HBM market growth drives memory manufacturer capital intensity and hiring across packaging and production.

ko.counterpoint: SK Hynix recruitment spike may reflect cyclical production surge rather than sustained demand; bonus structure sustainability questionable if AI capex cycle normalizes.

ko.executive_summary: Google significantly expands proprietary AI chip portfolio with TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max systems, positioning Arm-based Axion as inference alternative and creating supply diversification opportunities for Samsung and SK Hynix. NVIDIA leadership crisis—Jensen Huang's resignation—reshapes competitive dynamics as Anthropic and OpenAI advance AI-assisted chip design methodologies.
key_facts: Google unveils TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max AI systems with Arm-based Axion architecture
Google inference TPU volume now exceeds training TPU deployment
Anthropic and OpenAI using AI to design AI chips
Luminal secures $25 million funding for AI inference cost reduction
Jensen Huang resigns all roles at NVIDIA; Colette Cress assumes interim CEO
Shanghai chip supplier Innolight advancing IPO targeting 3 billion yuan
Alphabet stock climbs 3% on AI chip expansion; Microsoft +2%, Amazon marginal gain
Taiwan 00413A ETF rises 4% on TSMC ecosystem focus

implications.text: Google's expanded TPU lineup and Arm-Axion deployment signals hyperscaler commitment to chip sovereignty, reducing NVIDIA dependency and creating foundry volume for Samsung/SK Hynix memory integration.
TPU 8i Max inference volumes exceeding training represents margin expansion opportunity; Luminal $25M raise targets cost optimization, intensifying price competition in inference services.
Huang resignation creates strategic uncertainty; interim CFO leadership signals governance crisis that could accelerate customer diversification toward Google, AMD, and custom silicon.
Anthropic/OpenAI AI-designed chips reduce design cycle time and capital barriers, enabling new custom SoC entrants and threatening traditional design methodology incumbents.

ko.counterpoint: Google TPU architectural maturity and production economics remain unproven at scale compared to established NVIDIA demand; NVIDIA's dominant installed base and software ecosystem provide near-term resilience despite leadership turmoil.

ko.executive_summary: TSMC expands 3nm capacity in Kumamoto amid 'endless' AI chip demand, while Samsung commits 46 trillion won HBM hub investment at Onyang by 2028, intensifying memory-foundry co-integration competition. NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang's resignation triggers global supply chain uncertainty; interim CFO Colette Cress assumes leadership as geopolitical intelligence allegations complicate competitive dynamics.
key_facts: TSMC approves 3nm at second Kumamoto fab; CEO Kevin Zhang cites 'endless' AI demand
Samsung plans KRW 46 trillion Onyang HBM hub with five production lines, accelerating 2028 operations launch by one year
Jensen Huang resigns as NVIDIA founder-CEO after 33 years; Colette Cress interim CEO
Alice Huang (Huang's affair partner) intelligence concerns trigger U.S. counterintelligence investigation
National Pension Fund suffers ~4 trillion won NVIDIA valuation loss in four months
Trump nominates Tim Cook as potential NVIDIA CEO successor
China denies Alice Huang espionage allegations as U.S. tech containment tactic
Memory price hikes planned amid enterprise-consumer demand divergence

implications.text: TSMC 3nm Kumamoto expansion and Samsung Onyang HBM hub both targeting 2028 operations create duopoly memory-logic co-supply competition; capacity additions signal confidence in multi-year AI infrastructure cycle.

NVIDIA CEO intelligence allegations and U.S. counterintelligence scrutiny inject political risk into semiconductor supply chain; Taiwan/Korea favor vs. China dynamics now weaponized via executive vetting.
NVIDIA interim CFO leadership during multi-year AI capex cycle creates technology roadmap and partnership continuity risk; customer defection to TSMC custom silicon accelerates.
Planned memory price increases targeting enterprise AI while consumer demand softens indicates market segmentation; premium products insulate margins from commodity pressure.

ko.counterpoint: Samsung's 46T won Onyang investment scale and 2028 timeline subject to demand validation risk; NVIDIA's interim leadership may stabilize faster than geopolitical narratives suggest given Cress' financial credibility.
